sources.note: City of Barre charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 1 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 205(a)(1) provides that the legal voters elect biennially a Mayor.
City of Barre official website, 'Council and Mayor' page: lists 'Mayor Thom Lauzon.'

org_sources.note: City of Barre charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 1 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 205(a) provides that the legal voters of each ward elect one councilor annually for a term of two years, so each of the City's three wards (section 103) has two councilors serving staggered terms.
City of Barre official website, 'Council and Mayor' page: lists the Mayor and the six councilors by ward.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Barre City justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office.
